Ltd.}}}} | module = | website = {{URL|https://www.angelone.in/}} | footnotes = }} '''Angel One Limited''', formerly known as '''Angel Broking Limited''', is an Indian [[stockbroker]] firm established in 1996. The company got converted into a Public Limited Company, which will come into effect from 28 June, 2018, through a Certificate of Incorporation, issued of Registrar of Companies {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. The company is one of the largest independent companies listed for full service retail broking house in India with more than 13.8 million customers, and 4.3 million active clients on NSE {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. The company is a member of the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]],{{cite web|title=List of Members - Derivatives|url=http://www.bseindia.com/markets/Derivatives/DeriReports/membership.aspx?expandable=6|website=BSE India|accessdate=29 April 2015|page=Clearing No. 612}} [[National Stock Exchange of India]], [[NCDEX|National Commodity & Derivatives Exchange Limited]] and [[Multi Commodity Exchange|Multi Commodity Exchange of India Limited]].{{cite web|title=Angel Broking|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=29567511|website=Bloomberg|accessdate=29 April 2015}} It is a [[depository participant]] with [[Central Depository Services Limited|Central Depository Services Limited (CDSL)]].{{cite web|title=List of CDSL DP's|url=https://www.cdslindia.com/dp/dpdetails.aspx?dp_id=33200|website=Central Depository Services (India) Limited|accessdate=29 April 2015}} Currently, the services offered by the firm includes business of stock, currency and commodity broking, providing margin trading facility, depository services, and distribution of mutual funds {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. Angel One has also been providing customers with Portfolio Management Services. Their services include equity (cash delivery, intra-day, futures and options), commodity and currency segments and depository operations {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. The firm has also created Angel NXT, a digital wide platform for a wide range of authorised persons to leverage social media networks for client acquisitions, activation and engagement among others. As part of the broking and advisory services offered by the firm, it facilitates the opening of demat accounts for their clients {{Cite web |title=South Ind.Bank Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/south-indian-bank-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. == History == Angel Broking was incorporated on 8 August 1996 as a [[private limited company]].{{cite news |title=Angel Broking Ltd. |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/angel-broking-38941/information/company-history |website=Business Standard India |access-date=22 August 2021}} Later, Angel Broking was incorporated as a [[wealth management]], retail and corporate broking firm in september, 1997.{{cite news|last1=Sood|first1=Parina|title=Manage money, make money|url=http://www.franchiseindia.com/magazine/2014/november/Manage-money-make-money_116-1-3/|publisher=Franchise India|date=7 November 2014}} In November 1998, Angel Capital and Debt Market Ltd. gained membership of [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] as a legal entity.{{cite book|title=Study Of Best Practices In The Bfsi Sector For Marketing, Branding & Communications Plan|date=13 August 2011 |publisher=Sanjay Gupta|page=53|url=http://issuu.com/sanjaykumarguptaa/docs/study-of-best-practices-in-the-bfsi-sector-for-mar|accessdate=29 April 2015}} The company opened its commodity broking Division in April, 2004.{{cite web |title=Angel One A Brief History |url=https://smallbizbuddha.com/a-brief-history-of-angel-one/ |website=Small Biz Buddha |date=23 September 2022 |publisher=}} In November 2007, Birla Sun Life Insurance joined hands with Angel Broking for distribution of its insurance products.{{cite news|title=Birla Sun Life enters into alliance with Angel Broking|url=http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2007-11-26/news/27672172_1_angel-broking-insurance-products-birla-sun-life-insurance|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502210647/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2007-11-26/news/27672172_1_angel-broking-insurance-products-birla-sun-life-insurance|url-status=dead|archive-date=2 May 2015|agency=Press Trust of India (PTI)|publisher=Economics Times|date=26 November 2007}} The [[International Finance Corporation]] bought an 18% stake in Angel Broking for {{INRConvert|152|c|year=2007}} in December 2007.{{cite news|title=IFC Buys 18% In Angel Broking For Rs 152 Cr; Goldman, Macquarie In Deal With PFS|url=http://archive.vccircle.com/wordpress/2007/11/23/ifc-buys-18-in-angel-broking-for-rs-152-cr-goldman-macquari-in-deal-with-pfs/|access-date=8 May 2015|publisher=VCCircle|date=23 November 2007|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090608072424/http://archive.vccircle.com/wordpress/2007/11/23/ifc-buys-18-in-angel-broking-for-rs-152-cr-goldman-macquari-in-deal-with-pfs/|archive-date=8 June 2009|url-status=dead}} The company opened an office in Karol Bagh, New Delhi in October 2012.{{cite news |last1=Ghosh |first1=Ahona |last2=Gupta |first2=Apurv |title=Dinesh Thakkar's Angel Broking expands while other brokerages downsize |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/dinesh-thakkars-angel-broking-expands-while-other-brokerages-downsize/articleshow/16829773.cms |website=The Economic Times |access-date=22 August 2021}} In January 2013, a probe found the company and two other entities involved in fraudulent and unfair trade practices in transactions of shares of Sun Infoways during Feb-May 2001. As a result, [[Securities and Exchange Board of India|SEBI]] restrained from taking new clients for a period of two weeks.{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/sebi-restrains-angel-broking-other-stock-brokers-for-two-weeks/articleshow/18257918.cms?from=mdr|title=Sebi restrains Angel Broking, other stock brokers for two weeks|date=2013-01-31|work=The Economic Times|access-date=2019-03-28}} Angel filed an appeal against the SEBI order which was dismissed by the Securities appellate tribunal.{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/Tribunal-upholds-SEBI-order-against-Angel-Broking/article20679467.ece|title=Tribunal upholds SEBI order against Angel Broking|website=@businessline|date=22 October 2013 |language=en|access-date=2019-03-28}} Angel Broking began offered shares through an [[initial public offering]] in September 2020, and was listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and the [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] on 5 October 2020.{{cite news |last1=Raj |first1=Shubham |title=Angel Broking IPO to open on Tuesday: All you need to know about the issue |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/angel-broking-ipo-to-open-on-tuesday-all-you-need-to-know-about-the-issue/articleshow/78231989.cms? |website=The Economic Times |access-date=22 August 2021}} The company rebranded as Angel One in 2021.{{cite news |title=Angel Broking renames as 'Angel One'; Stock under pressure |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/article/news-sector-banking-financials/angel-broking-renames-as-angel-one-stock-under-pressure-121092400292_1.html |access-date=6 December 2021 |work=www.indiainfoline.com |language=en}}{{cite news |title=Angel Broking mulls name change |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/angel-broking-mulls-name-change/article35349860.ece |publisher=[[The Hindu Business Line]] |date=July 15, 2021}} In FY21, the company crossed 4 million unique Demat accounts {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. It crossed 17.6% market shares in incremental demat accounts between January to March 2021 {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. It was 4th largest company in terms of NSE active clients as of March 2021. In the same year, an average turnover of Rs. 4 trillion mark was crossed {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. As of March 2022, 17.5 billion mutual funds were distributed by the firm. And by March 2023, the company distributed mutual funds schemes of 40 AMCs, and AUMs worth Rs. 21 billion mutual funds were distributed by the company https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary . The company launched NXT 2.0, a new platform for authorised persons, with revamped sales modules and wealth products features. In FY24, the company commissioned its disaster recovery sites and data center in addition to investments in augmenting the technology infrastructure https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary . In June 2024, Angel One reached a client base of 2.47 crore (24.7 millions).{{cite web |title=Angel One rebounds from four-day fall on rise in client base, June order growth |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/angel-one-client-base-order-growth-june-12762752.html |website=moneycontrol.com |access-date=2 January 2025 |date=5 July 2024}} == Operations == The firm provides its customers with a wide range of financial services, including broking and advisory; the firm offers broking services across equity, commodity and currency segments, along with debt products. The company offers participation of clients initial public offerings undertaken by various companies {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. To complement its broking and advisory services, they offer other services as well: # Research Services: to ensure that the clients make informed investment decisions across equity, commodity and currency segments, research reports are published on a daily, weekly and monthly basis {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. # Investment Advisory: the company provides advisory services to retail customers to ensure that informed investment decisions are made by the customers. Multiple investment avenues are explored under this service, such as equities, debt, currency, commodities, derivatives, mutual funds, and insurance products {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. # Investor Education: The website of the firm acts as a knowledge centre that empowers investors, with an understanding of trading and investment products. There are certain other financial services provided by the firm. A few are {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}: # Margin Trading Facilities: This helps the clients leverage their eligible collaterals by funding the requirements of cash delivery segment of equities. Such funding is subject to exposure against margins that are a requirement of stock exchanges, with securities forming a collateral for such funding {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. # Distribution: Third party financial products such as mutual funds, health and life insurance projects, according to customer requirements. Such distribution is undertaken through digital and physical channels, such as Angel Broking or Angel BEE {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. # Loans Against Shares: Through AFPL, a subsidiary of the firm, loans against shares are made available to retail customers {{Cite web |title=Angel One Summary: Latest Updates and Details |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/angel-one-ltd/summary |access-date=2026-07-31 |website=India Infoline |language=en}}. == References == {{Reflist}} ==External links== * {{official|https://www.angelone.in/}} {{FinTech in India}} {{Online brokerages}} [[Category:Indian companies established in 1996]] [[Category:1996 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Financial services companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Financial services companies established in 1996]] [[Category:Online brokerages]] [[Category:Brokerage firms]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:2020 initial public offerings]]

Angel One Limited, formerly known as Angel Broking Limited, is an Indian stockbroker firm established in 1996. The company got converted into a Public Limited Company, which will come into effect from 28 June, 2018, through a Certificate of Incorporation, issued of Registrar of Companies .
The company is one of the largest independent companies listed for full service retail broking house in India with more than 13.8 million customers, and 4.3 million active clients on NSE . The company is a member of the Bombay Stock Exchange, National Stock Exchange of India, National Commodity & Derivatives Exchange Limited and Multi Commodity Exchange of India Limited. It is a depository participant with Central Depository Services Limited (CDSL). Currently, the services offered by the firm includes business of stock, currency and commodity broking, providing margin trading facility, depository services, and distribution of mutual funds .  
Angel One has also been providing customers with Portfolio Management Services. Their services include equity (cash delivery, intra-day, futures and options), commodity and currency segments and depository operations .   
The firm has also created Angel NXT, a digital wide platform for a wide range of authorised persons to leverage social media networks for client acquisitions, activation and engagement among others. As part of the broking and advisory services offered by the firm, it facilitates the opening of demat accounts for their clients .
